file_metadata.authority: Dolnytsky Typikon Part V Chapters I & II
file_metadata.scope: Patronal Feast Processions and Blessing Rites (Wing 2)
file_metadata.description: Defines the structural sequence of the Outdoor Water Blessing and Patronal Procession, specifying the micro-actions and roles for priest, deacon, and cantor.

roles.priest: Vest in phelonion, carry the hand cross on a decorated diskos upon his head, process from Altar to the font prepared outside or in the narthex.
roles.deacon: Carry censer, process ahead of priest, censing the route.
roles.cantor: Chant troparia of the Cross ('Save, O Lord, Your people...') and of the Patron Saint.

roles.priest: Stand before font facing east. Exclaim blessing, read the water blessing prayers.
roles.deacon: Say the litany of the water blessing, censing the water in the form of a cross.
roles.cantor: Sing 'Lord, have mercy' and respond to petitions.

roles.priest: Dip the hand cross vertically into the water three times in the form of a cross, singing the troparion 'Save, O Lord...' three times.
roles.cantor: Repeat the troparion of the Cross after the priest.

rubric.title: Sprinkling of the Temple and Faithful

roles.priest: Take the sprinkler, sprinkle the water toward the four directions, then sprinkle the church building, icons, and the people.
roles.cantor: Sing the patronal troparion and sessional hymns during the sprinkling.

roles.priest: Take the Monstrance (containing the Holy Eucharist) or the Patronal Icon, stand under the processional canopy in the nave.
roles.deacon: Open the church doors, stand before the priest with the censer.

roles.priest: Carry the Holy Eucharist or Icon slowly around the exterior of the church, blessing the area.
roles.deacon: Walk directly in front of the priest, censing backward toward the Eucharist/Icon.
roles.cantor: Chant the patronal stichera and troparia, preceding the clergy with processional cross, banners, and candles.

roles.priest: Stop at each of the four stations (East, South, West, North) to read the designated Gospel passage.
roles.deacon: Exclaim 'Let us be attentive!' and cense the Gospel and priest before each reading.
roles.cantor: Chant the Epistle, Alleluia, and respond to the Gospels.

roles.priest: Exclaim the station collect and bless with the Eucharist/Icon in the form of a cross.
roles.deacon: Intone special litanies for the peace of the world, civil authorities, founders, and the parish.
roles.cantor: Chant 'Lord, have mercy' (3x or 12x) after each petition.

roles.priest: Re-enter the church, place the Eucharist or Icon back on the Holy Table or tetrapod, exclaim the Te Deum, give final blessing, and intone the 'Many Years'.
roles.cantor: Sing the Te Deum conclusion and intone the 'Many Years' (Mnohaya Lěta).
